title: Recursion Tree
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Recursion
learningObjectives: Trace how drawBranch() calls itself twice at each level to generate the two child branches of a recursive tree
Identify the base case that stops the recursion when the branch length falls below a threshold
Predict how changing the branch angle slider reshapes the tree from a narrow spire to a wide fan
Explain how a few lines of recursive code produce an exponentially growing number of branches
Distinguish the recursive branch-length reduction factor from the branch angle as two independent controls of tree shape
